description: This file contains a PHP unit test class 'I18NTranslationImportAPITest' that tests the API related to internationalization translation imports in the OrangeHRM system. It includes setup routines, data providers, and test methods for creating and handling translation import API endpoints, along with placeholders for unimplemented methods.
